mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in 2 months signals strengthening demand, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 5% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in easing periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) grow by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% in a month signals weakening demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS decreases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in 2 months signals strengthening supply-side activity, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in low-growth environment
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and GDPC1 YoY growth < 2%.
